title: A main CI job that ends at its time cap raises an alarm the same day
why: Main's push runs ended cancelled at checks-windows-guard's 20-minute cap 11 times from Nov 9 to Nov 11 and nothing said so; the owner had already asked to raise the limits (owner 11:53 CST Nov 11: "i'd already told triage/coordinator to just raise the test limits ... pretty frusdtrating").
note: Missing guard under R16 (plan f8b11c2, 3.2). The stopgap raise itself is lane windows-guard-cap-stopgap. A cancelled-at-cap job on main counts as red, never as passed or skipped; the alarm names the job, its cap and the run. Red case first: a fixture run with a job cancelled at its timeout-minutes must alarm. Cost to state in its record. Related: health map red 2 (step owner-health-tab), the blind spot "timed-out job counted not red". Lane code-workflows started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium). Owner page save 11:59 CST Nov 12: item 549 pick a: every cap end on main opens an issue, cleared or not; #2745 (the cap alarm) checks cap ends before the clear rule.
source: owner 2026-11-11 11:53 CST, relayed by the retrospective session
